# BuzzFeed

> BuzzFeed is a digital media company delivering entertainment news, interactive quizzes, viral content, and community discussions across pop culture, celebrity gossip, TV, music, and politics.

BuzzFeed combines personality-driven quizzes, trending entertainment coverage, and user-generated content to engage millions of readers. The platform emphasizes interactive experiences, from daily games and polls to newsletters and community discussions spanning celebrity news, LGBTQ culture, political commentary, and viral internet moments.

## Interactive Quizzes & Games

- [BuzzFeed Quizzes](https://www.buzzfeed.com/quizzes): BuzzFeed's main quiz platform featuring personality, trivia, and pop culture quizzes
- [Trending Quizzes on BuzzFeed](https://www.buzzfeed.com/trending/quizzes): Directory of most popular BuzzFeed quizzes and trending user-generated content
- [Arcade](https://www.buzzfeed.com/arcade): BuzzFeed's daily games collection including word, trivia, and puzzle games
- [Showdown](https://www.buzzfeed.com/topic/showdown): Interactive voting and comparison games for entertainment showdowns and polls

## Entertainment & Celebrity News

- [TV and Movies on BuzzFeed](https://www.buzzfeed.com/tvandmovies): TV and movie recaps, streaming guides, and entertainment coverage for major shows
- [Celebrities on Buzzfeed](https://www.buzzfeed.com/celebrity): Celebrity news, gossip, and entertainment coverage featuring trending celebrities
- [Music](https://www.buzzfeed.com/music): Music quizzes, trivia, and playlist builders featuring BTS, pop stars, and artists
- [BuzzFeed LGBTQ](https://www.buzzfeed.com/lgbtq): LGBTQ news, queer culture, celebrity coverage, and community stories
- [Rewind](https://www.buzzfeed.com/rewind): Nostalgia-focused quizzes and throwback content for millennial pop culture fans

## News & Trending Content

- [The Best of the Internet News and Trends](https://www.buzzfeed.com/bestoftheinternet): Viral content, memes, and trending stories from Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit
- [in the news on BuzzFeed](https://www.buzzfeed.com/in-the-news): Trending news roundup covering politics, celebrity gossip, and viral moments
- [Politics](https://www.buzzfeed.com/topic/politics): US politics news, election coverage, and political commentary on trending issues

## Community & Engagement

- [Newsletters](https://www.buzzfeed.com/newsletters): BuzzFeed newsletter directory with daily digests, entertainment, and trending content
- [Buzz Chat: Share Your Opinions & Discuss](https://www.buzzfeed.com/buzzchat): Community discussion hub for sharing opinions on TV, pop culture, and celebrity news

## Shopping & Lifestyle

- [BuzzFeed Shopping: Product Guides & Deals](https://www.buzzfeed.com/shopping): Shopping guides and product recommendations for home, fashion, beauty, and retail

## Optional

- [Books](https://www.buzzfeed.com/books): Book quizzes, recommendations, and literature content featuring classics and BookTok
